subject: Willy
text: Before dying in the cell, Willy instructs Kain to seek out Bogard the Gemma Knight at the falls.

evidence.quote:
Willy: Kain.. Mana is in danger now.. We must let the Gemma Knights 
know about it.
Kain: .. Gemma..?
Willy: See Bogard at the falls. He is a Gemma Knight. He should know 
what to do.

subject: Monster entrance
text: A man reveals that the entrance used by the monsters leads to the outside.

evidence.quote: Man: The entrance for the monsters leads to outside. Take your chance!

subject: Julius
text: Julius informs the Dark Lord that the Tree of Mana is located in an overhead shrine and that a girl possesses the key to reach it.

evidence.quote: Julius: Yes, sir. The tree is in a shrine up there....Julius: A girl has the key to it.

subject: Dark Lord
text: The Dark Lord chases Kain and pushes him down the waterfall.

evidence.quote:
Dark Lord: I won't let you leave here alive!
(Dark Lord pushes him down the waterfall)
Kain: .. .. Ouch! .. Where am I? .. Where is this?

subject: Inn
text: Staying a night at the inn in Topple costs 10GP.

evidence.quote:
(Inn)
Howdy! 10GP/night! Wanna stay?

subject: Item shop
text: The Topple item shop sells Cure 2 for 40GP, Pure 3 for 30GP, Eyedrp 3 for 60GP, and Key 4 for 15GP.

evidence.quote:
(If you choose buy)
Cure  2    40GP
Pure  3    30GP
Eyedrp3    60GP
Key   4    15GP

subject: Weapon shop
text: The Topple weapon shop sells the Broad sword for 60GP and the Iron sword for 140GP.

evidence.quote:
(If you choose buy)
Broad      60GP
Iron      140GP

subject: Jena
text: After Hasim passes away from wounds sustained in the field, Jena joins Kain to travel to Wendel.

evidence.quote:
Hasim: Oh.. please.. take this girl to.. Wendel.. and.. see 
Bogard...... He will take care of the rest.. ....
Girl: Oh.. No.. Don't leave me alone, Hasim!
Kain: I'm looking for that Bogard, too. Why don't you come with me?
Girl: Oh .. Can I?
Kain: I can't leave you here alone. .. I am Kain.
Jena: Call me Jena.

subject: Mattock
text: Bogard instructs Kain to take the Mattock from the next room and use it to break rocks in the cave on the mountain's east side.

evidence.quote:
Take the Mattock 
in the next room! Go to the cave on the east side of the mountains.
Use Mattock to break rocks in the cave. See Cibba in the town called 
Wendel. He knows more.

subject: Battle
text: The house near the swamp entrance sells the Battle axe for 150GP.

evidence.quote:
(House near the entrance of the swamp)
One and only Battle for only 150GP! Want it?

subject: Magic Book of Cure
text: Kain rests in the western room of Kett's Tower and receives the Magic Book of Cure from Jena.

evidence.quote:
Jena: .. Kain..?
Kain: What?
Jena: I think you should be able to use Cure Magic.
Kain: Yeah. It should help.
Jena: .. Read this!
Received the Magic Book of Cure. Learned Cure!

subject: White Wizard
text: A White Wizard states that the lizardmen's nest to the south holds the key needed to open the Cave of Marsh.

evidence.quote:
White Wizard: Lizardmen's nest is to the south. They have the key to 
open the Cave of Marsh.

subject: Mirror
text: A man in Kett's Tower explains that the mystic Mirror reveals true colors and was thrown into a cave.

evidence.quote:
Guy: The mystic Mirror reveals people's true colors. I heard that the 
man here threw it away in a cave.

subject: Bronze
text: Defeating all the lizardmen in the Lizardmen's nest rewards Bronze.

evidence.quote:
(Lizardmen's nest. After killing all the lizardmen.)
Found Bronze!

subject: Mysterious Man
text: A man in the Cave of Marsh offers to join Kain to help find the Mirror and save the missing girls.

evidence.quote:
Man: Your friend is missing?
Many girls have disappeared in that place. They must be kept in the 
caskets at the basement. Looking for the Mirror? Do you want me to 
help?
(Choice)
Yes

subject: Sickle
text: A Sickle is found inside a room in the Cave of Marsh.

evidence.quote:
(Room in dungeon) 
Found Sickle!

subject: Iron
text: An Iron shield is found inside a room in the Cave of Marsh.

evidence.quote:
(Room in dungeon) 
Found Iron.

subject: Hydra
text: Defeating Hydra yields the Magic Book of Fire and the Mirror.

evidence.quote:
Defeated Hydra!
Found the Magic Book of Fire. Learned Fire!
Found the Mirror!

subject: Chain
text: The Chain weapon is found inside a room in Kett's Tower.

evidence.quote:
(Room in dungeon)
Found Chain!

subject: Vampire
text: Defeating the Vampire at the entrance of Kett's Tower rewards the Magic Book of Sleep.

evidence.quote:
Lee: That's my victim!

(After fight)
Defeated Vampire!
Received Magic Book of Sleep. Learned Sleep.

text: The Wendel item shop sells Cure 2 for 40GP, Pure 2 for 30GP, Eyedrp 3 for 60GP, Key 4 for 15GP, and Mattok 7 for 60GP.

evidence.quote:

Cure   2      40GP

evidence.quote:
(If you choose buy)
Broad         60GP
Iron (helmet) 140GP

subject: Julius
text: At the entrance of Wendel, the mysterious man removes his disguise and reveals himself to be Julius before kidnapping Jena.

evidence.quote:
(Man takes off his disguise)
Kain: Julius?! Why? You helped me before....
Julius: I was not sure if she was the right girl or not until I saw 
what happened inside there. I was waiting for this chance to get her! 
And now.... Glaives have her in our hands!

subject: Magic Book of Heal
text: Cibba gives Kain the Magic Book of Heal after Julius escapes with Jena in an airship.

evidence.quote:
Cibba: Then take this with you. 
Received the Magic Book of Heal. Learned Heal!

subject: Item store
text: The item store located south of Dwarf Cave sells Oil for 500GP.

evidence.quote:
(Item store located south from Dwarf Cave) 
Guy: Hello! May I help you?...
Oil      500GP

subject: Watts
text: After falling down a hole on the trolley in the mine, Kain recruits Watts to search for Silver.

evidence.quote:
(After riding the trolley and falling into the big hole)
Watts: Wow!? Are you okay?
Kain: .. Ouch!.. Oh..
(Watts walks over to Kain)
Kain: Thanks. Do you know this cave well?
Watts: Looking for Silver? Let's go together, then!

subject: Megapede
text: Defeating Megapede reveals a chest containing Silver.

evidence.quote:
Defeated Megapede!
 
(After opening the chest)
Found Silver!

subject: Watts
text: At Dwarf Cave, Watts sells Silver armor for 700GP, Silver shield for 505GP, and Silver sword for 562GP.

evidence.quote:
(Dwarf Cave)
(Go south one room from entrance)
Watts: I made some things out of that Silver! Take these and you can 
pass through Gaia!...
Silver (armor)   700GP
Silver (shield)  505GP
Silver (sword)   562GP

subject: Gaia
text: Gaia will only allow passage through its mouth if Kain is equipped with Silver gear.

evidence.quote:
Gaia: Whaaaa.. Doooon't walk in my moooouth.. Ooooo.. Yuck!!...Watts: I'll take it back and forge armor and swords! Gaia will let you 
in if you wear Silver stuff! Come see me at the Dwarf Cave!

subject: Bogard
text: After exiting Gaia Cave, Bogard joins Kain to pursue Glaive's airship refueling at the northern lake.

evidence.quote:
Wait, Kain!
(Bogard walks out of the cave)
Kain: Bogard! Jena was taken by Glaive..
Bogard: Cibba told me about that. Julius is good at disguising. But, 
don't worry. We can save her. Glaive's airship is refueling at a lake 
up north. I'll came with you and help! Let's go!

subject: Item store
text: The item store near the airship sells Silver helmet for 240GP, Cure 2 for 40GP, Ether for 320GP, Key 4 for 15GP, and Mattok 7 for 60GP.

evidence.quote:
(Item store near Airship)...
Silver (helmet)  240GP
Cure  2           40GP
Ether            320GP
Key   4           15GP
Mattok7           60GP

subject: Jena
text: Kain and Bogard locate Jena locked in a cell aboard the airship and plan to rescue her through the window.

evidence.quote:
Kain: Jena!
Bogard Hurry! It's moving!
Jena: This door is locked!
Bogard: How about the windows?
(Jena walks over to the windows then she walks back over to the cell 
door.)
Jena: It may open.
Kain: I'll get you from outside!
